scripts.dev:https: sh -c 'CERT_DIR=$(cd .. && pwd)/.certs; NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS="$CERT_DIR/nubixshop-local.crt" exec next dev -p 3002 -H 0.0.0.0 --experimental-https --experimental-https-key "$CERT_DIR/nubixshop-local.key" --experimental-https-cert "$CERT_DIR/nubixshop-local.crt" "$@"' --
scripts.deploy: npm run build && pm2 restart nubix-frontend
